blocks.content: The Commission consists of a Chief Information Commissioner and not more than ten Information Commissioners.

rows: Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha

items: Maximum Strength: Remember that the maximum number of Information Commissioners is 10, not 5 or 15.
Selection Committee Composition: The Chief Justice of India is NOT part of the CIC selection committee; it consists only of the PM, LoP in Lok Sabha, and a Cabinet Minister nominated by the PM.
Appointment Authority: Members are appointed by the President on the recommendation of the selection committee.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Information Commission consists of a Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) and not more than ten Information Commissioners (ICs).
Members are appointed by the President of India based on recommendations from a designated three-member selection committee.
The selection committee comprises the Prime Minister as Chairperson, the Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha, and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
Commissioners must be persons of eminence in public life with significant experience in law, science, social service, management, journalism, or administration.
Commissioners must not hold any office of profit, be connected with any political party, or serve as Members of Parliament or State Legislatures.
